tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /skyed lhas rtag gtor gyi 'dod gsol dge/ dpal rdo rje nag po zhal bzhi pa yum chen sring mo bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa gtor ma 'di la brtan par bzhugs shing bzhes la/ sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa srungs/ dkon mchog gi dbu 'phang bstod/ dge 'dun gyi sde skyongs/ bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe srings/ 'jig rten gyi khams kyi dge legs spel/ khyad par rje btsun sa skya pa'i bstan pa gdung brgyud lha sde mi sde 'khor 'bangs longs spyod gzhis mkhar khang sogs mdor na sa skya par gtogs so 'tshal gyi 'gal rkyen bar chad mi mthun pa'i phyogs thams cad zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ tshe bsod dpal 'byor lung rtogs legs pa'i yon tan thams cad rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ brtan g.yo snod bcud thams cad dbang du bsdu bar mdzad du gsol/ 'gal rkyen bar chad dgra bgegs log 'dren thams cad rdul du brlag par mdzad du gsol/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad bde blag tu stsal du gsol/ bye brag tu yang rje btsun sa skya pa'i gdung brgyud dri ma med pa chu bo'i rgyun ltar 'byon zhing / de dag thams cad kyang sngags 'chang chos kyi rgyal po yab sras dang thams cad mkhyen pa ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams gyi rnam thar dang rjes su mthun pa'i mdzad phrin las/ rje btsun gong ma dbang po'i grangs ldan gyi bstan pa rin po che bshad sgrub kyi sgo nas/ nam langs pa la nyi ma shar ba ltar ches cher gsal zhing skye dgu kun gyi mgon du 'gyur ba dang / phan bde'i rtsa lag dam par zhabs pad bskal brgyar brtan cing / phrin las rgya mtsho'i gos can khyab par mdzad du gsol/ bdag ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros sangs rgyas bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po dang / ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams mthu stobs dbang phyug bkra shis grags pa rgyal mtshan dpal bzang po mi brgyud dang bcas pa la byang chub ma thob kyi bar du 'go zhing 'ches pa dang bsrung skyob sba ba'i phrin las dang sdongs grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/
